name: Learning from Failure (failure-case loop enhanced OpenCUA agent)

system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Application-specific keyboard shortcuts for LibreOffice Calc / Writer are also injected when relevant.
system_prompt_style.note: Terminal reminder and LibreOffice hints are conditionally added to the context; the OpenCUA agent prompt file itself is not in the bundle.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: an MLLM observes the current computer state (e.g., a screenshot) and predicts the next action conditioned on the task instruction
env_context_strategy.note: GUI agent: the environment is known only through screenshots, and nothing is injected up front. SWE-oriented values fit poorly.

context_compaction.note: The OpenCUA agent history handling was not in the truncated bundle. history_n=5 images is seen only in the seedagent runner, which is not the default agent.

observation_format.note: Based on the seedagent runner. OSWorld also supports a11y_tree and som; the OpenCUA runner's options were not seen.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Disables the check that detects when the agent emits the exact same PyAutoGUI code multiple times in a row.
tool_call_format.note: The agent emits PyAutoGUI code and a computer.search call.

tool_count.note: The action space is PyAutoGUI code plus computer.search, but the OpenCUA tool list was not in the bundle.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: The agent is able to activate terminal via special hotkey to perform system-level operations.
edit_primitive.note: The README module table lists no file-editing tool; edits happen via GUI or terminal.

tool_schema_source.note: The tool schema definition was not in the bundle.

protocol_standardization.note: The repository was truncated and no dependency/grep evidence was available.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: iteratively producing a trajectory of state–action pairs until the task is completed
loop_primitives.note: Adds a pre-click verification sub-call. The offline failure-case loop is a human/LLM development process, not a runtime loop.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: the agent is encouraged to reformulate its plan or switch to an alternative interaction strategy

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: which use a single agent to perform both planning and control
multi_agent_topology.note: The search tool queries an LLM, which is not an agent.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: which use a single agent to perform both planning and control

human_in_loop.note: The run loop and config were not in the bundle. Human verification in the paper is offline patch review.

short_term_state.note: The OpenCUA agent state was not shown. The uipath memory.py is a different vendored agent.

long_term_memory.note: The software-manual retriever is a curated knowledge base; persistence across runs was not shown.

self_verification.evidence_quote: The agent is then prompted to verify its action conditioned on the cropped screenshot, task instruction, action history, and ongoing reasoning context
self_verification.note: Coordinate verification is on by default and can be disabled with --disable_coordinate_verification.

retry_policy.note: The README flag list shows no task-retry option.

termination_condition.note: Repetition detection triggers recovery mode, not termination. Model-declared DONE/FAIL follows OSWorld convention.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Follow the official OSWorld instructions to set up a VMware, VirtualBox, or Docker environment
execution_isolation.note: Docker, AWS, and Aliyun providers are also available.

filesystem_access.note: Full access within the VM; the evidence comes from a vendored agent prompt.

network_policy.evidence_quote: export OPENAI_API_KEY=<% PUT-YOUR-OPENAI-KEY-HERE %>    # OpenAI key (used by the search tool)
network_policy.note: No network policy configuration was seen, and the agent installs packages with wget.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: description="Run end-to-end evaluation on the benchmark"

guardrails.evidence_quote: The agent will no longer crop the click target and ask the model to verify/adjust the coordinate before executing.
guardrails.note: Default-on coordinate verification validates click actions before execution; disableable via flags in run_opencua.sh. Closest value; this is verification, not a safety policy.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Learning from Failure: Inference-Time Self-Improvement for Computer-Use Agents

open_source.note: No LICENSE file was in the evidence.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: a scalable, model-agnostic amplifier of base-model capabilities
model_agnostic.note: OpenCUA is served through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
